mod.name: Fauna of the Stone Age: Vanilla Values
mod.text:
Tired of elephants being able to feed your entire village? Want to cram a whole car-sized corpse into a single crock pot? Someone saying Fauna of the Stone Age is broken?

Look no further than Fauna of the Stone Age: Vanilla Values! Where we set the drop rates exactly to what you find in the base game, regardless of realism, logic or game balance!

So beyond the tongue and cheek, we're coming up on four years of Fauna of the Stone Age development and the most prevalent critique has been around drop rates. I dislike the philosophy behind the base game drops but I also want folks to be able to experience the game how they like and tweaking all 8000+ drop related values is a daunting task for anyone. To address this I've put together this add-on mod, being as literal in base game derived values as I can even when the base game values don't really make sense. Each animal will have the exact drops of the base game animal with the closest weight to its own, with Carnivorans being split off due to following a different pattern than the rest. If this mod ends up getting used by enough people I'll cover the other clades as well in between working on my main projects. I'll also fill out the lists as relevant to projects.

Currently this mod adjusted values of the following:
Fauna of the Stone Age: Elephantidae
